verdict.rationale: Mercury's evidence pack describes a business bank account with API/CLI/MCP access for managing one's OWN Mercury account (payments, invoicing, cards, transactions) — not a banking-as-a-service/embedded-finance program that lets a developer issue licensed bank accounts to their own end customers under Mercury's charter. This story targets a fundamentally different product category (BaaS/embedded banking platform), which is outside what Mercury is shown to offer.
